title: Uncertainty Makes It Stable: Curiosity-Driven Quantized Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2511.11743v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices faces two critical challenges: maintaining accuracy under aggressive quantization while ensuring predictable inference latency. We present a curiosity-driven quantized Mixture-of-Experts framework that addresses both through Bayesian epistemic uncertainty-based routing across heterogeneous experts (BitNet ternary, 1-16 bit BitLinear, post-training quantization). Evaluated on audio classification benchmarks (ESC-50, Quinn, UrbanSound8K), our 4-bit quantization maintains 99.9 percent of full-precision F1 (0.858 vs 0.859) with 4x compression and 31 percent energy savings versus 8-bit, while both achieve statistical parity with full precision (p > 0.05).   Crucially, curiosity-driven routing simultaneously improves accuracy and stability: on Quinn, F1 increases from 0.802 to 0.809 while cross-fold variance drops by 85 percent (p < 0.001, Levene's test), with reductions

translated_title: 不确定性使其稳定：好奇心驱动的量化混合专家模型
translated_abstract: 在资源受限设备上部署深度神经网络面临两个关键挑战：在激进量化下保持精度的同时确保可预测的推理延迟。我们提出了一种好奇心驱动的量化混合专家框架，通过基于贝叶斯认知不确定性的路由机制在异构专家（BitNet三值量化、1-16位BitLinear、训练后量化）之间进行路由，同时解决这两个问题。在音频分类基准数据集（ESC-50、Quinn、UrbanSound8K）上的评估表明，我们的4位量化保持了全精度F1分数的99.9%（0.858 vs 0.859），相比8位量化实现了4倍压缩和31%的能耗节省，且两者在统计上与全精度模型无显著差异（p > 0.05）。至关重要的是，好奇心驱动的路由同时提升了精度和稳定性：在Quinn数据集上，F1从0.802提升至0.809，同时交叉验证方差下降了85%（p < 0.001，Levene检验）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种好奇心驱动的量化混合专家框架，通过基于贝叶斯认知不确定性的路由机制在异构量化专家间分配计算，在4位量化下保持99.9%的全精度性能并节省31%能耗的同时，显著提升了模型的精度与稳定性（交叉验证方差降低85%）。
